comment: Which distance provider is used to rank sources for distance-based source selection.
modal: Selects the service that calculates the distance between a shipping destination and each source when the Distance Based source selection algorithm runs.
basis: group:Distance Provider for Distance Based SSA

comment: The travel mode Google uses to measure distance — driving, walking, or bicycling.
modal: Chooses the Google travel mode for distance calculation: **Driving**, **Walking**, or **Bicycling**. Used when the Google distance provider is selected.

comment: Whether sources are ranked by physical distance or by travel time.
modal: Chooses the metric Google returns for ranking sources: **Distance** (physical distance) or **Time to destination** (travel time). Used when the Google distance provider is selected.
